profile.headline: Engineman at US Navy
profile.summary:
Proficient in programming language and object oriented: C#, Java, Groovy and Python. 
Analyze the requirements, design the solution, validate the design, implement the design, test the solution, and document the solution in Incremental/Agile System Development Life Cycle Model. 
Proficient in operating system and active directory: Window XP, Window Vista, Window 7, Window Server 03, Mac OS X, Linux Ubuntu and Linux Fedora.
Proficient with web server: Internet Information Service.
Proficient in web development: XHTML, HTML, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, and Dreamweaver.
Proficient in database management system and language: SQL, MySQL, MSSQL and Oracle Database Management System.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Lead 1 of the 5 teams within the Personalization Program
Provide technical direction and guide a team of 6 developers and 1 SDET
Utilize Hazelcast cache to allow developers to switch between GitLab branches for testing
Implementing the JWT cache using the expiration value from the token so the application doesn’t make unnecessary calls to the Authorization API
Converting multiple Spring Boot Blocking Rest API into Reactive Webflux with NoSQL Couchbase
Come up with a lesser complexity solution during Program Increment Planning that fit with the existing program architecture design
Refine features by researching all the technical details and breaking the feature down into stories
Design and implement a feature to be flexible by using configuration-driven due to the risk of scope creep from the external team
Design, architect, and develop multiple Java microservices applications using GitLab CI/CD,  Docker, Kafka, Openshift, Kubernetes, Webflux, and Spring Boot during conversion from classic using configuration-driven (Low-Code)
Help the program to ramp up team headcount by interviewing the potential candidates
Help and mentor Jr. Software Engineers.
Collaborate with teammates and the business team to deliver features before the deadline.
Performance testing Rest API with Taurus framework and JMeter.
Work with multiple teams in the program to develop service API to personalized member experience on the web and mobile apps
Maintain and enhance the Program Portal using ReactJs
Able to deliver 2 features that help Property and Casualty sister company to generate $10 mil plus sales in the fiscal year within 2 months with the company
Deliver reliable applications to the members and their families who have and currently protecting our nation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
After a month started in my position, I took on the role of lead developer and complete the project with my team on a tight deadline.
Giving a project with a very little requirement, I have to design and architect the application.
Developed micro-services using Nodejs, Express, and Mongoose.
Lead developer and subject matter expert for Medtronic project
Patients engagement extension project for Watson Heath using NoSQL, SQL, and Service Stack rest framework
Using existing Application Service Engine to develop queue processor with MS Queue
TDD using NUnit, AutoFixture, and Moq framework
Work directly with release team for software  delivery

company.name: Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Metro Brokers

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Take on the role of a Java developer since no one in my team willing to work on Java.
Review software requirements specification to implement technical design specification. 
Analyze and design solutions for application enhancement based on business requirements. 
Using ASP .NET send and receive XML data to middle tier. 
Using jquery ajax to send data to C# aspx page, and aspx page invoke WCF services.
Implement middle tier transaction using Argo proprietary language, Web API Restful Service and C# .NET WCF service.
Using Java and Groovy to read Jms Queue, parse the message, and send to .Net WCF. 
Analyzed function in Sales and Services application for enhancement. 
Using XSLT parse XML data with JavaScript to display User Interface. 
Document the analysis for next phrase of software enhancement. Research and fix defect. 
Rewrite Software Design Document. 
Create and implement Technical Design document. 
Create and perform unit test case.

positions.title: Certified Programmer I
positions.description:
•	Paperless Application using .NET WCF soap.
•       Reading third party queue using Java.

positions.title: Entry Level Programmer
positions.description:
•	Argo Fraud Application using ADS language, HTML, Javascript, and ASP.NET.
•	Argo Sale and Service Application using ADS language, HTML, Javascript, and ASP.NET.

positions.title: EMR Software Technical Support
positions.description:
•	Install, configure and troubleshoot eIVF client and server EMR software. 
•	Maintain, configure and install Windows server. 
•	Convert COM+ VB6 code into C# .NET web service. 
•	Developed window form application and window service application using C#. 
•	Install, configure, troubleshoot and setting up email for workstation. 
•	Check HL7 error log to troubleshoot connectivity with external lab.

positions.title: Lead Clerk
positions.description:
•	My daily tasks are clerical support for three Assistant Regional Census Manager and supervise around 10 clerks for daily operation. 
•	I create, copies, and edits makes insertions and deletions, and moves text throughout a single document or from one electronic file to another. 
•	I also receive telephone and personal callers, and direct them to appropriate office employee. I did Quality Control applicant folder with PeopleSoft system. 
•	My other task is to retrieve several reports and create spreadsheet to have a more understandable description of the report. 
•	I also use the information from report and other spreadsheet to create new spreadsheet report.
•	Every time we start new operation, I have to maintain the training schedule for 51 Local Census Offices. 
•	I also maintain the entire field Regional Technician weekly schedule.

positions.title: EN3
positions.description:
•	Performed preventive maintenance, repair, and operates 4 aircraft elevators, 12 stations, 28 pumps, 4 engine rooms, 4 Deck Edge Doors, 2 Divisional Doors, and Hydraulic System. 
•	Team leader, supervised the dewatering team to dewatering space during general quarter and exercise. 
•	Gauge calibration petty officer maintained over 300 gauges in the shop at and above 98% readiness all time.
